lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Shadows stretch across the hollow floor
I’m tracing circles near the bolted door
A static hum begins to fill the air
There’s something shifting in the velvet glare
The moonlight cuts a jagged, silver line
You look for shelter, but you’re already mine
My pulse is syncing with the midnight beat
Dragging the silence down into the street
[chorus]
Wait for the signal in the dark
Watch as the current leaves its mark
It’s a rhythm that pulls you from the bone
Leaving you trembling and all alone
Dangerous secrets bloom in the heat
Under the rhythm of the city street
Don’t close your eyes, don’t look away
I am the hunter till the break of day
[verse]
Tension coils beneath the neon sign
The wires humming with a lethal design
You feel the weight of every passing breath
Dancing so close to the edge of death
Synthetic whispers echo in the wall
Waiting for kingdom and empires to fall
The grit of the guitar begins to bite
Swallowing reason into the lightless night
[chorus]
Wait for the signal in the dark
Watch as the current leaves its mark
It’s a rhythm that pulls you from the bone
Leaving you trembling and all alone
Dangerous secrets bloom in the heat
Under the rhythm of the city street
Don’t close your eyes, don’t look away
I am the hunter till the break of day
[outro]
